argv:

'); hepta_page_b64=$(printf '%s' "$hepta_return_page" | base64 | tr -d '
'); hepta_viewport_b64=$(printf '%s' "$hepta_return_viewport" | base64 | tr -d '
'); printf '{"schema":"hepta.return-receipt.v149.1","operation_id":"a3bb5ae1a953a68fe86971c0d051ea10","launch_exit_code":%s,"launch_b64":"%s","page_b64":"%s","viewport_b64":"%s"}
